key_facts: July 22 UPDATE (Reuters/Straits Times/Irish Times/AP News July 22): No European national wildfire emergency declared yet through July 22 (3 days left in July 1-25 window). (1) SPAIN (0.39->0.35): Guadalajara blaze reached ~32,000 ha (79,000 acres) but started stabilizing Tuesday & receded Wednesday July 22 (5 villages allowed home); PM Pedro Sanchez visited Guadalajara July 22 noting >100k ha burned across 22 major fires without declaring a national emergency; AEMET still warns extreme danger & 42-44C Mediterranean surge Thu July 23 before Fri July 24 cooldown. (2) PORTUGAL (0.23): Same Iberian 42-44C heatwave peak July 22-23 + Vouzela blaze + lowest national threshold for nationwide situacao de calamidade/alerta. (3) GREECE (0.14->0.17): Heatwave intensifying July 22-25 (>41C, +5.8C above normal, midday outdoor work banned July 22) as Iberia cools Friday. (4) FRANCE (0.09->0.10): Var/Cotignac fire surged to 2,500 ha (400 evacuated, 1,100 firefighters, dozens of homes damaged) + 2 firefighters killed in Gironde July 21 + Hautes-Alpes blaze, though winds eased July 22 and France has high national emergency threshold. (5) ITALY (NEW 0.07, replacing North Macedonia 0.05->dropped): North Macedonia & Western Balkans drenched by severe hailstorms/rain July 21-22 (11 hospitalized in Skopje); Sicily >40C with active wind-driven wildfires destroying olive groves and Council of Ministers frequently declares stato di emergenza. Outside 0.08: Cyprus (41C outdoor work ban), Bulgaria, Albania.
